description: The fixed action vocabulary. A post may carry only these verbs; the CLI rejects any other and the skill treats it as notify-only. Actions are verbs with arguments, never commands.

verbs.meaning: Upgrade the product to at least the fixed version.
Disable or remove an installed agent skill.
Remove an MCP server from every client configuration.
Rotate a credential that may have been exposed.
Stop installing from or using a marketplace or package.
Review a configuration setting by hand.
